item.title: Don't Feed The Foxes
item.description: Scripture: SONG OF SOLOMON 2:13-17 (NASB) 13 The fig tree has ripened its fruit, and the vines in blossom have given forth their fragrance. Arise, my darling, my beautiful one, and come along! 14 My dove, in the clefts of the rock, in the hiding place of the mountain pathway, let me see how you look, let me hear your voice; for your voice is pleasant, and you look delightful.
